title: Semantic Versioning System
description: Build a semantic versioning library that parses, compares, sorts versions and matches ranges.

steps.title: Implement SemVer parser
steps.description: Build a function that parses a version string `"1.2.3"` into `{major, minor, patch, prerelease, build}`. Handle prerelease tags like `-alpha.1` and build metadata like `+build.001`. Print the parsed object showing all components.
hints: Use regex named groups to capture major, minor, patch, prerelease, and build segments
Prerelease is separated by a hyphen, build metadata by a plus sign
Split prerelease and build identifiers by dots and store as arrays

verification.successMessage: Parser extracts all semver components including prerelease and build
verification.failureMessage: Parsed output missing major, minor, or patch fields

steps.title: Add version comparison
steps.description: Implement `compare(v1, v2)` that returns `-1` if v1 < v2, `0` if equal, and `1` if v1 > v2. Compare by major, then minor, then patch numerically. Print comparison results between several version pairs.
hints: Compare numeric fields (major, minor, patch) in order, returning on first difference
For equal versions, a version without prerelease is greater than one with prerelease
Prerelease identifiers compare lexically for strings and numerically for numbers

verification.successMessage: Comparison returns correct ordering for all tested version pairs

steps.title: Implement version sorting
steps.description: Create a `sort(versions)` function that orders an array of version strings correctly according to semver precedence rules. Print the sorted list, one version per line from lowest to highest.
hints: Use the compare function as a comparator for Array.sort or equivalent
Remember that 1.0.0-rc.1 sorts before 1.0.0-rc.2 and before 1.0.0
Handle edge cases like 1.0.0-1 sorts before 1.0.0-alpha (numeric before lexical)

verification.successMessage: Sorted versions appear in correct semver order
verification.failureMessage: Sorted list missing or versions in wrong order

steps.title: Add range parsing (^, ~)
steps.description: Implement parsing of caret (`^1.2.3`) and tilde (`~1.2.3`) ranges. Caret allows changes at the leftmost non-zero version. Tilde allows patch-level changes. Print the parsed range showing lower and upper bounds.
hints: A range can be represented as {min, max, includeMin, includeMax} or as a comparator set

verification.successMessage: Caret and tilde ranges parse to correct lower/upper bounds
verification.failureMessage: Range bounds missing or incorrect in output

steps.title: Implement range matching
steps.description: Build `satisfies(version, range)` that checks if a version string falls within a given range. Support exact versions (`1.2.3`), caret ranges (`^1.2.3`), and tilde ranges (`~1.2.3`). Print match results for several version-range pairs.
hints: Parse the version and the range bounds, then check if version is between min and max
Exact version range is just that one specific version
Test edge cases like 1.2.3 satisfies ^1.2.3 but 2.0.0 does not

verification.successMessage: satisfies correctly returns true/false for matching and non-matching versions
verification.failureMessage: Range matching output missing pass/fail results

steps.title: Add prerelease/precedence rules
steps.description: Implement full prerelease sorting and precedence per the semver spec: `alpha` < `beta` < `rc` < release. Support numeric prerelease identifiers. Print a sorted list of versions mixing release and prerelease versions.
hints: Prerelease versions have lower precedence than their normal version counterpart
Compare prerelease identifiers field by field: numbers compare numerically, strings compare lexically
Numeric identifiers always have lower precedence than alphabetic identifiers per the spec

verification.successMessage: Prerelease versions sort correctly: alpha < beta < rc < release
verification.failureMessage: Prerelease sorting output missing or in wrong order
